$schema: see scripts/audit-check.mjs — this file has no schema of its own
$comment: The machine-readable half of the 'Accepted, with reasons' table in docs/security-advisories.md.
scripts/audit-check.mjs runs `pnpm audit --prod` in CI and fails on: an advisory that is not
listed here; an entry past its reviewBy date; an entry whose advisory is no longer reported (so
a list entry cannot outlive the thing it excuses); and an entry whose voidIf grep now matches,
which is how a 'not reachable' reason stops being taken on trust.
Never add an entry here without the row in docs/security-advisories.md that explains it.

allow.reason: XMLBuilder only. Every call site in this repo imports XMLParser and nothing here ever constructs XML; the fix is a major version whose parser option semantics change, which would need the docx and Palo Alto parsers re-verified.

voidIf.because: the acceptance rests on XMLBuilder never being imported — if one appears, this stops being unreachable and the entry is void.
